description: Where planetary mechanics meets the soil of Souss. A physicist and a marketer decoding NASA's cosmic data to save our roots. We have the energy and the strategy we just need the architects of code to bridge the gap. Dare to grow with us?
summary: Key Soil is a 100% biodegradable seed sachet that turns packaging into a precision farming tool and an organic fertilizer. Each sachet carries a QR code. When a farmer in Souss-Massa scans it, they receive a personalized crop rotation plan in Darija audio and video, based on NASA POWER, SMAP, and GPM data, local soil salinity and groundwater levels, crop characteristics, and their own priority: Save Water, Save Soil, or Earn More. After sowing, the farmer buries the sachet, which decomposes in 60 days and enriches the soil. Key Soil addresses the Field Shift challenge by making NASA data accessible to farmers without literacy or expensive technology. It is vital because Souss-Massa faces 7 years of drought, a groundwater deficit of 300 million m³ per year, and 62% saline wells, while plastic packaging continues to pollute the soil it depends on
details:
What does it do and how does it work?

Key Soil is a biodegradable seed sachet with a QR code that delivers a personalized crop rotation plan. The farmer scans the code, the system detects location (Taroudant, Chtouka, Tiznit), then fuses NASA data with local soil data. A scoring algorithm calculates a Soil Health Score (0-100) for 12 local crops, optimizing 40% Soil Health, 30% Water Saving, and 30% Farmer Priority (Save Water / Save Soil / Earn More). The farmer receives 1 Main Recommendation, 1 Alternative, and 1 Crop to Avoid, with Darija audio and a 30-second video. After sowing, the farmer buries the sachet. Its inner PLA layer (corn starch + beeswax) and outer kraft paper layer decompose in 60 days and become organic matter.

Benefits:

For farmers: +25% yield after 2 cycles, -30% water use, free advice included in seed price, works on any phone. For soil: +0.5% organic matter per year, -40% chemical fertilizer, 0 plastic waste (8g saved per sachet). For the planet: NASA data becomes real field action in arid regions.

Intended Impact:

Pilot with 500 farmers in Souss-Massa, then scale to 1 million sachets in Morocco and the Sahel. We will measure water saved, organic matter increase, yield, and plastic avoided. Our goal is that no farmer loses his field for lack of information.

Tools Used:

NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM IMERG, MODIS NDVI via NASA APIs. Development: Python 3.11, Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy, QR Code Library, Leaflet, Figma, Canva, GitHub. Hardware: Physical prototype of kraft paper + PLA sachet, Android phone for scanning demo.

How is it creative? We did not build another app farmers will never download. We embedded NASA intelligence inside the object farmers already buy every season: the seed sachet. The packaging is the technology, and the waste becomes the fertilizer.

Factors considered:

Low literacy (audio + icons), low connectivity (lightweight web page), low income (free for farmer), drought and salinity in Souss-Massa, local crops and market prices, and cultural habits of farmers in Douars.
